operators.name: view_as_real_complex64
semantics: Implements torch.view_as_real for complex64 tensor: output = torch.stack([x.real, x.imag], dim=-1) with stride [262144, 32768, 256, 2, 1].
Output shape is input shape + [2] and dtype is float32.
Preserves original ordering: x.real and x.imag stack along the new last axis.

operators.name: log_softmax_dim_last
semantics: Applies log_softmax over the last dimension (dim=-1, size=2).
For each vector of length 2, computes logsumexp over the two components and subtracts it from each component.
Stable computation: m = max(a,b); out_i = x_i - m - log(exp(a-m)+exp(b-m)).

operators.name: group_norm_fp32
semantics: Applies group normalization with weight=None and bias=None (no affine parameters).
Input is considered as shape [N, C, D1, D2, D3] where actual shape is [512, 8, 128, 128, 2], hence D1=128, D2=128, D3=2.
Groups are formed along channel dimension C: each group has C//num_groups = 2 channels.
For each sample and group, mean and variance are computed over all spatial and D3 dimensions within that group.
Output = (x - mean) / sqrt(var + eps).
Group norm operates independently per sample and per group, no cross-sample stats.
Converts complex64 tensor [512,8,128,128] to real float32 tensor [512,8,128,128,2].
Real part occupies index 0 of last axis, imaginary part index 1.
Applies log_softmax over the last dimension (size 2) for each element independently.
Preserves shape and stride; output dtype float32.
Computes log_softmax of [real, imag] pair per spatial position.
Group normalization without affine weight/bias.
num_groups=4, eps=1e-5.
Input shape [512,8,128,128,2]; channels grouped as 2 channels per group.
Mean/variance computed over all elements in each sample-group across spatial and last dims.
No learnable parameters used.
Returns the group-normalized tensor of shape [512,8,128,128,2], dtype float32, device cuda:0.
